notes.subject: רגמתם
notes.rationale: Tok i stap wanpela taim tasol long Tanakh — 'stap olgeta wantaim ol' (JPS) o 'ol man i kamap wantaim' (Geneva/KJV 'their council').

notes.subject: רדם
notes.rationale: רדה: 'ol i bosim' (JPS, ASV) o 'ol i makim em long bos' (KJV 'with their ruler') — gram a i save lukim tupela pas.

notes.subject: ol nem bilong ol lain
notes.rationale: Lista bilong foa lain: Binyamin, Yehuda, Zevulun, Naftali — nem bilong ol lain i kamap wanwan.

translation: Long hap Binyamin, yangpela yet, ol i bosim ⟨em⟩; ol bikman bilong Yehuda wantaim ol man i kamap wantaim ol; ol bikman bilong Zevulun, ol bikman bilong Naftali.

tokens.gloss: wantaim ol man i kamap wantaim ol
